occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. export-control records and Huawei market-share and chip-access records
occurrences.quote_span: The biggest maker of network gear, Huawei struggled to hold onto its market share under sanctions that have blocked its access to most U.S. processor chips and other technology.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Huawei Technologies

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Department of Justice Huawei charging announcements and superseding indictments
occurrences.quote_span: The U.S. announced the criminal charges in early 2019 and has since expanded the allegations.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Huawei Technologies

occurrences.checkable_against: Statements by Chinese government officials concerning U.S. Huawei prosecutions
occurrences.quote_span: Chinese officials said the U.S. government has engaged in “economic bullying” and improperly used national security as a pretext for “oppressing Chinese companies.”
occurrences.speaker: Chinese officials
occurrences.subject: Huawei Technologies

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. District Court indictment and criminal docket for Huawei Technologies
occurrences.quote_span: Huawei Technologies, a leading Chinese tech company, faces a criminal racketeering trial in New York over charges that it stole technology, plotted to steal U.S. trade secrets and committed wire and bank fraud, among other crimes.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Huawei Technologies

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. District Court indictment against Huawei and subsidiaries
occurrences.quote_span: The indictment alleges that, besides stealing trade secrets, Huawei and some of its subsidiaries did business in North Korea despite U.S. sanctions there

occurrences.subject: Huawei Technologies
